note: _qui lotus est, non indiget_ [nisi] _ut_ [pedes] _lavet_ – he that is washed needeth not [but] to wash [his feet] (Douay Version). The longer version is that of the Clementina, Weber/Gryson gives the shorter text. – N.M. Haring: Historical Notes on the Interpretation of John 13:10. _Catholic Biblical Quarterly_ 13 (1950) 355–380.

_fac citius_ – do (it) quickly. The comparative form expresses the superlative: as soon as possible; möglichst rasch. Urban Holzmeister: Die katholischen deutschen Bibelübersetzungen des Neuen Testaments seit Schluß des vorigen Jahrhunderts, _Zeitschrift für katholische Theologie_ 41 (1917) 303–332, at p. 323.
